units.source_text: 每天你从大学研究室回家，我都迎接你。

en.t: Every day, when you came home from your university laboratory, I was there to greet you.

units.source_text: 从郊外停车场到你家有两条路，一条穿过热闹的商业区，一条经过寂静的杂木林。

en.t: There were two roads from the suburban parking lot to your house: one passed through a busy shopping district, and the other went through a quiet grove of mixed trees.

units.source_text: 你回家的时间虽然并不固定，然而我们总是在半路上相遇。

en.t: Although the time you came home was not fixed, we always met each other halfway.
